Hi Alice,

Thanks again for the time last week — really appreciated the visibility into OrbitApps' roadmap for inference-driven features in H2. Per our conversation, I put together a structured renewal that aims to: preserve current unit economics during your growth window, add predictable burst capacity, and give you an option to co-term our observability add-on in year 2.

High-level proposal (attached: renewal_summary_v2.pdf):
- Term: 36 months (Dec 2026 – Nov 2029) with staged ramping commitments
  - Year 1: 120M tokens reserved (monthly smoothing)
  - Year 2: 360M tokens reserved (staged unlock 1 Jul 2027)
  - Year 3: 720M tokens reserved (backstop burst pool + scale triggers)
- Pricing: blended per-token price with step-down at each staged unlock (detailed in attachment)
- Credits: 10% onboarding credit applied to Q1 invoices to offset migration work
- Billing: quarterly invoicing with optional annual prepay (can do annual upfront to secure deeper discount)
- Auto-renew: default ON at term end; customer may elect opt-out 60 days before renewal window (we can add explicit opt-out language in amendment)
- Co-term option: add Redwood Observe (observability) in Year 2 with separate SKU; co-terming would align billing to Nov 2029 and pro-rate onboarding fees

Next steps I recommend:
1) Review the attached summary and the SOW redline we sketched (sow_amendment_draft.docx).
2) If the staged ramp looks right, I can circulate a final amendment and a DocuSign link for signatures.
3) If procurement wants different billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly) we can show pricing delta.

If you'd like, loop in your procurement contact and I'll coordinate payment terms and DocuSign. Happy to hop on a short call to walk through the numbers.

Best,

Hi all — thanks for the patience. Pricing and contract language below to address the three asks.

1) Billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly):
- Quarterly invoicing (standard): blended per-token $0.00045 (reflects staged discounts).
- Monthly invoicing (administrative premium): blended per-token $0.00048 (+6.5% price premium to cover processing and reconciliation).
- If OrbitApps elects annual prepay for Year 1, we can offer an additional 8% discount on top of the blended price.

2) Early-exit / true-up protection:
- True-up window: At the end of Year 1 we offer a 6-month pro-rated true-up mechanism. If reserved tokens > consumed tokens, OrbitApps receives a credit equal to 50% of the unused reserved tokens at the Year 1 blended price applied to future invoices (not refundable).
- If OrbitApps exceeds reserved tokens by >20% in any quarter, excess usage billed at overage rate (standard overage: $0.00060/token) and triggers optional burst top-up for the next billing cycle.

3) Co-term opt-in for Redwood Observe (Y2):
- Product addition is opt-in during the annual planning window for Year 2 (30–90 days prior to the Year 2 start).
- On opt-in, onboarding fee is pro-rated to the nearest quarter and waived if signed within the first 60 days of Year 2. Co-term billing will align to Nov 2029; any onboarding prorate credited to first invoice.

Next steps:
- Camila to attach amendment language (I reviewed and this aligns to commercial).
- Mina to confirm whether OrbitApps prefers monthly or quarterly invoicing and whether they plan to prepay Year 1.
